subject: Re: Encord Intro via Michael Letterio - Data Visualization/Curation Front-End
text:
Hi Kamil,

Let me share the test criteria.

Category
Details
Cloud Region
- East US
SDK Scenarios
- Search datasets (by tag, by natural language)
- Search images within a dataset (by tag, by label, by natural language)
- Add images and apply labels via SDK
- Label 1M samples via SDK — measure throughput/speed
Data Import
- Maximum number of images uploadable at once via UI
- Convenience of data upload through UI
- Image upload speed
- How to import data in a labeling format not natively supported by Encord
Data Export
- Download speed
- Convenience of data export
- How to export data in a labeling format not natively supported by Encord
Data Access Control
- Per-user dataset access restriction
- Per-user cloud storage access restriction
Data Browsing
- Natural language search
- Other search capabilities for datasets or images
- Dataset-level search
- Image-level search
Annotation Editing
- Per-sample tagging
- Per-dataset tagging
- Per-sample labeling methods
Adding Data to Existing Datasets
- How to append new data to an already-existing dataset
Labeling Assistant
- Assisted segmentation labeling (e.g., auto-segmentation tools to reduce manual effort)
Scalability
- Browsing and downloading without performance degradation at large image counts
Data Backup
- Backup strategy and support for dataset backups
Multiple Cloud Storage Connections
- Can multiple cloud storage accounts/buckets be connected simultaneously?
Multiple Annotation Imports per Dataset
- Can multiple annotation sets be imported into a single dataset?
Version Control
- Dataset and annotation versioning support
Data Visualization
- Available data visualization features

subject: Re: R.e. Encord demo
text:
Hi Matt,

I see. I think it adds complexity that is not necessary.
Whether we record the human and telepresence to a robot, or record the human directly, it both utilizes the same data input.

What we discussed after the meeting.
-We can utilize the mocap stage we have at our office to record a dataset, this does not have to wait for a proper egocentric setup that is in development.
-Synchronization is a difficult thing to quantify and will require a test setup to verify. We can record the first dataset without verification and utilize the timecoding as-is.

We'll work on a plan to record a dataset in the coming weeks as a quick first test, to keep momentum.
If you have any suggestions on setups to record, that you think would be relevant to your customers, just let us know.
